guide.text: Martian Manhunter's signature gear. When allies cast Ultimates, he gains Attack and Physical Defense bonuses. When enemies cast skills or Ultimates, he restores HP. The faster allies cycle their Ultimates, the quicker Martian Manhunter reaches his power spike, while also effectively countering high-frequency casters.
